plan.subject: Barbie doll particles

slots.subject_description: separate small particles that burst out of Barbie doll

plan.sheet_prompt:
One illustration of 4 separate small particles, one at each position: top-left, top-right, bottom-left and bottom-right, evenly spaced.
Particles of Barbie doll: small things that fly out when the Barbie doll emoji is pressed. Draw only the particles listed, never Barbie doll itself and never a character, a person, a face, a hand, writing or a logo.
Style: glossy cartoon look, bold clean shapes, vivid colours.
Outline: none. Draw every particle directly on the backdrop with no outline, stroke, die-cut edge or halo around it.
Each particle is alone at its position and centred there, and differs from every other one in kind, size or angle:
Particle 1 (top-left): pink heart
Particle 2 (top-right): blush
Particle 3 (bottom-left): rose flower
Particle 4 (bottom-right): pink heart, large
Consistency: the same drawing style, lighting and colour quality for all 4 particles.
Background: one seamless, flat, uniform pure #00FF00 green backdrop from edge to edge in exactly one shade, with no texture, no shading, no tint, no gradient, no vignette, no glow, no shadows, no noise, and nothing on it but the particles.
Spacing: every particle has a generous empty margin on every side (at least 20% of its own size), and no particle touches another.
plan.video_prompt:
Animate this illustration sheet as a 3-second clip. Every character performs its own big, highly expressive, cartoon-style animation in place, inside its own cell, showing a wide range of emotions:
1. pink heart, with big lively expressive movement in place
2. blush, with big lively expressive movement in place
3. rose flower, with big lively expressive movement in place
4. pink heart, large, with big lively expressive movement in place
Animation style: wide emotions, highly expressive faces and bodies, exaggerated squash and stretch, anticipation and follow-through, clear facial animation (eyes, eyebrows, mouth), secondary motion on ears, tails and props, each character on its own rhythm, lively and full of personality. Never a static pose and never only a gentle sway.
Keep every character inside its own slot of the 2x2 layout; nothing may touch or cross a slot edge, and characters never interact with one another.
Empty slots stay empty: do not add any character, object or effect to them.
Static camera, no zoom, no pan, no cuts. Keep the one flat pure green (#00FF00) background exactly as it is, the same shade everywhere: no shadows, no gradient, no noise, no glow.
Keep each character's design, proportions and colours unchanged and do not add outlines or borders.
